Rain, neon, and the Tyrell skyline of the first film.

How Los Angeles 2019 connects

  • Work: Blade Runner (1982) — The 1982 film is set in Los Angeles 2019.
  • Faction: Tyrell Corporation — Tyrell's pyramid dominates Los Angeles 2019.

What is Los Angeles 2019?

Los Angeles 2019 is Scott's overcrowded coastal megacity of Asian signage, constant rain, and police spinners over the Tyrell pyramid.

Key threads lead to Blade Runner (1982) and Tyrell Corporation.
